idea-plugin.name: Swift LSP Support
idea-plugin.description: Swift language support through SourceKit-LSP from an existing Swift toolchain. Finds the toolchain on PATH or in common Windows installation locations. Set SWIFT_TOOLCHAIN in Language Servers > Swift (SourceKit-LSP) > Environment variables to select a toolchain explicitly. Swift and SourceKit-LSP are never downloaded or installed. Requires a complete user-installed Swift toolchain, including its platform SDK and runtime.
